definitions.gloss: old age, elderly years, advanced age
definitions.explanation: The period of life in which a person is old. A neutral, formal term for the stage of life following middle age. Used in medical, sociological, and literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {老年|ろうねん}になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧で⟦いたい→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I want to stay healthy even in old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老年|ろうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごしている→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is spending his old age peacefully.

examples.japanese: {老年|ろうねん}{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}される→左右される：26073_sayuusareru⟧。
examples.english: Health management in old age is greatly influenced by lifestyle habits formed from a young age.

notes:
USAGE:
A neutral, somewhat formal term for old age. Often used in compound forms like {老年|ろうねん}{期|き} (the elderly period), {老年|ろうねん}⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (geriatric medicine). More formal than ⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧ (elderly person), which can sound slightly blunt.

LIFE STAGE TERMS:
- {幼年|ようねん}: early childhood
- ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧: boyhood, youth
- ⟦{青年|せいねん}→青年：03292_seinen⟧: young adulthood
- ⟦{壮年|そうねん}→壮年：19755_sounen⟧: prime of life
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧: middle age
- {老年|ろうねん}: old age

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老年|ろうねん}{期|き}: old-age period, elderly years
- {老年|ろうねん}⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧: geriatrics
- {老年|ろうねん}⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧: elderly population
